title: Database description: Russian fricatives recorded in 198 real speech sentences from 59 speakers
token_or_recording_size: 22,561 target fricative tokens; 198 sentences; 77 recording sessions
annotation_target: target-fricative intervals; SAMPA/IPA target labels; neighboring-sound and speaker/session metadata
manual_scope: MAUS supplied initial phone segmentation; every target-fricative boundary was manually inspected and corrected. Surrounding phone alignment remains automatic and is not admitted as a manually grounded phone tier.
decision_reason: Primary controlled production with exhaustive human correction of target-fricative boundaries; only that target subset qualifies for the manually grounded warehouse.
evidence_summary: Dataset/article report 59 speakers and 22,561 target fricatives. All target-fricative boundaries were manually checked/corrected after MAUS preprocessing; archive access is controlled, so observations are indexed but not redistributed.
